tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.57
§ Pochereth of Zebaim = "here the cutting off"
a servant of Solomon whose descendants returned from exile with Zerubbabel

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Pokereth-Tsebajim, one of the 'servants of Solomon'
strongs_1890.derivation: from the active participle (of the same form as the first word) feminine of an unused root (meaning to entrap) and plural of H6643 (צְבִי); trap of gazelles;
